about_the_game:
This is a visual novel from the perspective of high school student Kobayashi Kuro, who somehow has to come to terms with the hearts of two girls and is targeted by higher beings who abuse his life and his world as a gameboard for their perfidious and cruel game.

In the mid-2020s, Kobayashi Kuro, Sakiko Miyu and Sakurano Aihara are about to enter their final year of high school. Kuro has just returned to his old home, which he left as a child. Miyu and Aihara can't stand each other and Kuro is always the one caught in the middle. Time and again, he more or less involuntarily ends up with one of the girls who has romantic feelings for him. Kuro soon realizes that his life consists of more than just teenage love dramas when his teenage life suddenly turns into a cruel gameboard of higher beings from higher planes of existence from which there is no escape. Kuro must confront the power of time manipulation and travel through an otherworldly dimension to save Miyu, Aihara and himself from an ever-repeating spiral of death. On his journey, Kuro must learn more about his old home, an old legend about his family and fathom his own heart, that of the two girls and that of his enemies in order to win the game.

  • High-quality 1080p assets in anime style

  • Characters move their mouths when speaking

  • Visual effects such as rain, flying orbs indoors and magical particle effect transitions for magical creatures

  • Japanese voice samples to bring each character to life

  • Backgrounds with multiple layers

  • Many great soundtracks for every situation

  • Fully playable with the controller

  • Customize the controller inputs as you like, the way you like it

  • Choose between a "Light" and a "Dark" menu theme

  • Choose between many different text boxes

  • Choose between the normal mode "ADV" and the book mode "NVL"

  • Read past dialogs divided by chapters in the dialog browser

  • Get in-game achievements

  • View unlocked CGs at any time in the menu

  • View information about characters in the menu

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content that may be disturbing to the end user. This includes suicide, murder, self-harm, gory descriptions of death and various mental illnesses.
